name: BANK-05 standing-order cancellation versus settlement race

data.sql: DELETE FROM bank_orders WHERE player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank05_race_payer');

tests.name: Fund payer through authenticated banking workflow
Make the order due at a deterministic future timestamp

data.sql: UPDATE bank_orders SET next_run_at=to_timestamp(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::bigint+10),last_occurrence_at=NULL WHERE bank_orders_id=@{bank05_race_order_id};

tests.name: Capture due time and align actual scheduler task

data.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM next_run_at)::bigint FROM bank_orders WHERE bank_orders_id=@{bank05_race_order_id};
INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES('test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled','1','int') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='1',type='int';

tests.name: Isolate scheduler to bank standing-order tick

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=(name='bank_standing_orders_tick'),next_due_at=CASE WHEN name='bank_standing_orders_tick' THEN to_timestamp(@{bank05_race_due}) ELSE next_due_at END;

tests.name: Race player cancellation against actual scheduled settlement
Verify cancellation serialization yields either zero or one complete settlement

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN b.enabled=FALSE AND ((COUNT(o.*)=0 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=b.player_id AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=100 AND COALESCE((SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=b.to_id AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE),0)=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bank_transactions WHERE tx_group_id LIKE 'bank-order-'||b.bank_orders_id||'-%')) OR (COUNT(o.*)=1 AND MAX(o.outcome)='paid' AND MAX(o.amount)=25 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=b.player_id AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=75 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=b.to_id AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=25 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_transactions WHERE tx_group_id='bank-order-'||b.bank_orders_id||'-'||EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(o.scheduled_for))::bigint)=2)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM bank_orders b LEFT JOIN bank_order_occurrences o ON o.bank_orders_id=b.bank_orders_id WHERE b.bank_orders_id=@{bank05_race_order_id} GROUP BY b.bank_orders_id,b.enabled,b.player_id,b.to_id;

tests.name: Replay scheduler at the same occurrence after cancellation
Retry does not create a second payment or occurrence
Verify retry retained the same 0-or-1 settlement and ledger count

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN NOT b.enabled AND COUNT(o.*)<=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_transactions WHERE tx_group_id LIKE 'bank-order-'||b.bank_orders_id||'-%')=COUNT(o.*)*2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM bank_orders b LEFT JOIN bank_order_occurrences o ON o.bank_orders_id=b.bank_orders_id WHERE b.bank_orders_id=@{bank05_race_order_id} GROUP BY b.bank_orders_id,b.enabled;
